title: WinLean compatibility requirements
description: What this machine must keep supporting. true = required (WinLean preserves it), false = not needed (rules may reduce it). A requirement that is not declared is treated as required. This file is also the canonical list of requirement keys used by src/WinLean.Compatibility.psm1.

printer.description: Local or network printing is used.

networkPrinting.description: Printers are used over the network.

bluetoothAudio.description: Bluetooth headphones or speakers are used.

xbox.description: Xbox app, Xbox services or Xbox networking are used.

gamePass.description: PC Game Pass / Microsoft Store games are used.

microsoftStore.description: The Microsoft Store is used to install or update apps.

wsl2.description: Windows Subsystem for Linux 2 is used.

virtualization.description: Third-party virtualization software (VMware, VirtualBox, ...) is used.

remoteDesktop.description: Remote Desktop (incoming or outgoing) is used.

windowsHello.description: Windows Hello (face, fingerprint, PIN) is used.

telemetryDiagnostics.description: Diagnostics that depend on telemetry (for example Feedback Hub reports) are used.

gpuVendorUtilities.description: NVIDIA / AMD / Intel control software is used.

rgbSoftware.description: RGB or peripheral control-center software is used.

fileSharing.description: Files or folders are shared with other devices.

smb.description: SMB network shares are used (as client or server).

developerMachine.description: The machine is used for software development.

gamingMachine.description: The machine is used for gaming.
